title: Before any fund: the foundation check and goal mapping
objectives: Run the foundation check before recommending any fund.
Capture the four facts about every goal.
Explain why fixing gaps first builds trust.
body_md:
No fund is suggested until the client's goals, horizon and risk profile are written down.

## Before investing: the foundation check

- Emergency fund in place (typically several months of expenses in liquid or bank savings)
- Adequate term life and health insurance
- High-interest debt (credit cards, personal loans) being cleared first

If these are missing, the first recommendation is to fix them. That builds trust faster than any fund.

## Goal mapping

For every goal capture: what it is, the amount in today's money, the target year, and its priority (must-have or nice-to-have). Short goals (under 3 years) lean on debt and liquid funds; long goals (7+ years) can carry more equity.
example: A 28-year-old wants to start a ₹15,000 SIP. She has no emergency fund and a ₹90,000 credit-card balance. The first recommendation is to clear the card and build three to six months of expenses in a liquid fund, then start the SIP.
say: Before we talk about any fund, let's understand what this money is for and when you'll need it.
Let's get your emergency fund and insurance in place first.
never: Start the SIP today, we'll sort the rest later.
Everyone should put money in equity first.

check.q: Before suggesting any fund, what must be checked first?
o: Emergency fund, term and health insurance, and high-interest debt
check.why: The foundation check comes first. If it is missing, fixing it is the first recommendation.

check.q: Which of these is NOT one of the four things captured for every goal?
o: The fund the client has already chosen
check.why: For every goal capture: what it is, amount in today's money, target year and priority.

check.q: A client has a 36% credit-card balance and no emergency fund. What do you recommend first?
o: Clearing the high-interest debt and building an emergency fund
An NFO with a good track record
check.why: Fix the foundation first: high-interest debt, emergency fund and insurance.
